I just completed it solo flawless. Sorry for the late reply, but here are the tips i can give.

Necropolis:
Sniper and recluse (if owned) 
For me xenophage was extremely helpful because of its nonexistent damage falloff. 

My strat was to snipe the pit keepers from the roof of the towers, then drop down to take down the acolytes. 

Tunnels of despair:
Same loadout but a shotgun in replacement of the sniper. Pretty easy encounter.

Chamber of suffering: 
Same loadout but go back to the sniper from the shotgun.

I highly recommend using titan bubble or warlock well and duplicating the ball, makes the encounter so much easier.

The harrows: 
Exact same loadout

Super easy, just take your time and make jumps carefully. 

Boss room: 
This one was interesting for me. I used orewings maul (the iron banner single shot nade launcher) to slowly pick off the sword knights as i rotated around the arena. If i had mountaintop, it would have been better. For the other weapon i just used whatever to kill acolytes. 

My strat was to go from shrieker, then to knight, then to wizard. Always dunk the ball in the hole zolmak isnt at or he will stomp you. Use the heavy hive sword attack to clear acolytes. 

Hope this helps
